title: Drawing
description:
A vector shape drawn on a `Map`.

Drawings are the annotation layer — outlines, highlights and sketched-in features the game
master adds over the artwork. Unlike `Map/canvas`, which is a raster, these stay editable and
can be moved between map layers.

Like `Wall`, a drawing is a plain `Codable` value stored encoded in `Map/drawings`, and its
derived geometry is cached — call `invalidate()` after editing `data` directly.

- SeeAlso: `Map/drawings`, `Wall`

id.description:
The unique identifier for this drawing.

A UUID string generated when the drawing is created.

data.description:
The drawing's vertices, as a flat list of alternating x and y coordinates.

- Note: Edit through `update(_:)`, which also invalidates the cached geometry.
- SeeAlso: `points`

layer.description:
Which map layer the drawing sits on.

Determines whether it is drawn under or over the tokens.

strokeWidth.description: The outline width, in map coordinates.

strokeColor.description:
The outline color, as an RGB string.

## Examples
- `"#ff0000"`

fillColor.description: The fill color, as an RGB string; `nil` leaves the shape unfilled.
